chunks: We spread the earth a carpet; what comfort We provide!

key_terms.الْمَاهِدُونَ: The best spreaders/makers of comfortable beds

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about God spreading the earth?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Adh-Dhariyat underscores God's deliberate act of preparing the earth as a cradle (mahd) for humanity, highlighting divine benevolence and order. The term 'al-Mahidun' is interpreted not only as 'the best spreaders' but also as those who provide a comfortable resting place, reflecting the Shia emphasis on God's mercy in creating a habitable world for human spiritual and physical sustenance.
